paite: Ka tapa, ka dan mangngilh ke'n; himahleh ka thupiakte na lungtang in kem hen.
heading: Tuailaite Kiang A Thuhilhna
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

paite: Nite sawtna leh damsung kumte leh muanna, nang a hong kibehlap ding ahi ngal a.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

paite: Zahngaihna leh thutak in nang hon nuse kei hen; na ngawng kimvel in vial inla; na lungtang dohkan tung ah amaute gelh in.
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

paite: Huchi in Pathian leh mihing mitmuh in deihsakna leh theihsiamna hoih na mu ding hi.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

paite: Na lungtang tengteng toh TOUPA ah muang inla, nangmah theihsiamna ah kinga ke'n.
english: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

paite: Na lampi tengteng ah amah thei inla, huchi in ama'n na lampite apitang ding hi.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

paite: Nangmah mit ah pil ke'nla; TOUPA kihta inla, gilou taisan in.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

paite: Na lai a ding in damna ahi ding a, na guhte a ding in guhngek.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

paite: Na van in TOUPA zahtak in, na punna tengteng a gah masate toh in.
english: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

paite: Huchi in hauhna in na pangte adimlet dia, na belte uain thak in adimlet ding hi.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

paite: Ka tapa, TOUPA sawina musit ke'nla; abawlhoihna leng chimtak sam ke'n.
english: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

paite: Pa'n akipahna tapa asalh bang in; TOUPA'N a-itte asal ngal a.
english: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

paite: Pilna mumi leh theihsiamna mumi'n nuam asa hi.
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

paite: Huai a vante lah dangka vante sang in ahoihzaw ngal a, huan huai a punna dangka- eng hoih sang in.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

paite: Rubi suang sang in amanphazaw; huan amah toh na thil deihte na tehpih thei kei ding.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

paite: Akhut taklam ah nite sawtna a-om a; akhut veilam ah hauhsaknate leh zahtakhuaina.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

paite: Alampite nopna lampite ahi a, alampite tengteng muanna ahi.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

paite: Amah len tintente a ding in hinna sing ahi; amah nei den michih in nuam asa uhi.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

paite: TOUPA'N pilna in lei amukhia a; theihsiamna in vante ahihkipta hi.
english: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

paite: Atheihna in thuknate akitam a, huan vante'n adaitui ataksak uhi.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

paite: Ka tapa, na mitte a kipan amaute paimangsak ke'n; pilna hoih leh ngentelna kem gige in.
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

paite: Huchi in na kha a ding in hinna ahi ding ua, na ngawng a ding in kilawmna.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

paite: Huchi in bittak in na lampi ah na pai ding a, na khe akisui kei ding hi.
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

paite: Na lup chiang in, na lau kei dia; ahi, na lum ding a, na ihmut alim ding.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

paite: Lauguihna kihta ke'n, ahong pai chiang in, giloute hihgawpna leng lau sam ke'n.
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

paite: TOUPA na kimuanna ahi sin ngal a, na khe thang a awk lou ding in aveng ding hi.
english: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

paite: Amu dingte a kipan thil hoih it ke'n, hih ding a na khut thilhihtheihna a-om lai in.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

paite: Na invengte kiang ah, na kiang a na neih lai in, pai inla, hong nawn in, huchi in zingsang chiang in ka hon pe ding, chi ke'n.
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

paite: Na invengte siatna ding gilou ngaihtuah ke'n, na kiang ah bittak in ateng chih thei in.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

paite: Aziak bei in mi toh kina ke'n, gilou bangmah na tung a ahihkeileh.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

paite: Hiamgammi eng ke'n, alampite bangmah tel ke'n.
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

paite: Kilawm lou lah TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi ngal a; himahleh athuguk mitangte kiang ah a-om hi.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

paite: TOUPA hamsia migiloute inn ah a-om; himahleh midiktatte tenna avualzawl hi.
english: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

paite: Ama'n nuihsan hatte anuihsan a, himahleh kingainiamte kiang ah hehpihna apia hi.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

paite: Mipil in thupina gou aluah ding; himahleh zumna mihaite kaisanna ahi ding hi.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
